snippet.title: Roads & Riches: Traveling Merchant Simulator - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Travel across faraway lands, sell wonderful wares, and find magical treasures - all to win over the world's hearts, minds... and wallets! Grow your caravan with 1-4 players in this Traveling Merchant Simulator!

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3987430/ 

Follow along with the game's Development on our Discord: https://discord.com/invite/QppnydUuET 

#indiegame #simulatorgames #gaming
